W09_linear_motor_end_block.notes: Rod sockets + NEMA17 boss register for the traverse axis (motor held by W16). Print on its base, 40% infill, 4 walls.

W10_linear_idler_end_block.notes: Rod sockets + 608ZZ pocket supporting the free end of the T8x8 screw.

W11_lm8uu_traverse_carriage.notes: Two LM8UU bores (15.2 mm, tune with Z01) + T8 flange-nut mount (16 mm PCD). Print standing on the -x face.

W12_angle_adjustable_guide_arm.notes: Carries F06/F07. Concentric arc slots centred on the mandrel contact point give +/-60 deg of guide angle with 5 deg index marks.

W13_w05_axis_riser_11mm.notes: Lifts retained W05 end guide to the 37.0 mm mandrel axis.

W14_limit_switch_rod_clamp.notes: Home and end microswitch clamp on the outer 8 mm rod; slide to set trip points (home: carriage x 45 mm).

F08_load_cell_mount.notes: Channel cradle for the fixed end of a 1 kg bar load cell; clamped by F13 with 4 x M2.

F12_sensing_roller_yoke.notes: Slides over the load-cell free end; 2 x MR62ZZ on an M2 axle form the tension-sensing roller.

F13_load_cell_clamp_cap.notes: Cap that clamps the load cell into F08 (0.3 mm preload) with 4 x M2.

W15_nema17_body_clamp_rotation.notes: Split collar holding the rotation NEMA17 body (axis 37 mm); 2 x M2 pinch, 4 x M2 wood screws. Print on the -x face, 4 walls.

W16_nema17_body_clamp_linear.notes: Split collar holding the traverse NEMA17 body (axis 22 mm, 0.7 mm floor rests on the plywood). Print on the -x face, 4 walls.

W17_camera_mast_foot.notes: Foot bracket for the 30 x 18 mm plywood camera mast; M2 wood screws.

W18_camera_arm.notes: Arm from the mast top holding a 38 x 38 mm USB board camera (4 x M2, 34 mm pattern - MEASURE) over the coil. Print on the mast-side face.

F09_spool_stand_left_608_bore.notes: Supersedes R3 F01 (which had no bearing bore). Derived from the R3 F01 STEP.

F10_spool_hub_8mm_bore.notes: Supersedes R3 F03 (5.2 mm bore) for an 8 mm axle in 608ZZ bearings. Derived from the R3 F03 STEP.

F11_dancer_pivot_post.notes: Pivot post for F04: 10k pot bushing is the pivot (A0 dancer angle). MEASURE pot bushing.
